headline: Let every room share the soundtrack
intro: Bring Sonos and IKEA Symfonisk speakers into Home Assistant, then make music part of the rhythm of your home. Play favorites and playlists, group rooms, or let an announcement briefly duck the music before it returns to its previous level.
highlights: Play streaming links, playlists, favorites, and music from a local library
Queue tracks and search your Sonos music library from automations
Use speakers for announcements and monitor alarms, batteries, and home theater settings
